title: workBenches bench catalog (config/bench-config.json) after feature 029
description: Structural contract for the bench catalog. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by devcontainer.test/test-bench-catalog.py and listed in $comment fields: the catalog matches config/release-lock.json in both directions (FR-054); Electrical Engineering has no benches and the other three categories at least one (FR-052); copy fields contain only single-column printable characters and no version-like token outside the allow-list (FR-053); simBench names OpenMM and ESM and not AlphaFold or ESMFold (FR-055). Readers ignore unknown fields; all new fields are additive.

benches.description: Catalogued benches keyed by name. Names may begin with a digit (365Bench); every consumer looks them up as data (FR-056).
benches.$comment: Key set equals the bench repositories in config/release-lock.json, matched by path and URL (FR-054).

line.$comment: Single line, no control characters (FR-048 range); '-' alone is the worker's empty-field sentinel (research R3). Wide, fullwidth, combining, zero-width and bidi formatting characters are rejected by the catalog test (FR-053, NB-6).

copyItem.$comment: No version-like token: a standalone number (not joined to a letter), dotted or not, or v<N> / version-<N>; allow-list 'Microsoft 365', 'Dynamics 365' (FR-053).

path.$comment: Same rule as setup_selection.py benches and the fail-closed apply check (FR-058).

category.$comment: Must name a defined category; electrical-engineering has no benches (FR-052).

bench.$comment: Other fields are tolerated (readers ignore unknown fields) but the draft-only 'draft' and 'evidence' fields of bench-copy-draft.json are not copied into the catalog.
